content: Secure registration: enterprise apps use admin-invite (pending grant row server-side, short-lived token, accept requires verified identity, revocable, role assigned by admin not body) or self-service with fixed default role + approval, never client-chosen role. Invitation token proves link possession only, not email ownership. Cidaas/cidaas/Auth0/WorkOS patterns: invite row with state machine (initiated/revoked/accepted/expired), single pending invite per email, assignable-role policy (inviter cannot grant role above own).
